Default angle style wraps URLs containing spaces in angle brackets

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"url_escape_style\":\"angle\"}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<a href=\"/file (1).pdf\">file</a>", options)
    println(result)
}
```
